title: Loud and Clear
description: Brynjolf introduces the player to the Thieves Guild. Guild Master Mercer Frey assigns a job at Goldenglow Estate: burn three beehives and clear out Aringoth's safe to punish the owner for cutting off honey shipments to Maven Black-Briar.

base_facts: I am a member of the Thieves Guild and recruit new blood.
I vouched for the new recruit before Mercer Frey.
Maven Black-Briar is one of the Guild's most important clients.

MERCER_BRIEFING: I brought the recruit to meet Mercer Frey, the Guild Master.
GET_JOB_DETAILS: I gave the recruit the Goldenglow job: burn three hives and clear Aringoth's safe.
RETURN_TO_BRYNJOLF: The recruit finished the Goldenglow job. I paid them their cut.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The Goldenglow matter is settled. Maven has another job lined up.
Quest finishes. Player is rewarded and pointed to Maven Black-Briar for the next job.

The secret sewer entrance leading into the estate To set the beehives on fire you can use a torch , the Fire Breath Shout, or a fire-based spell ; simply standing next to a hive with a torch or spell equipped will.
As long as you've completed the job to the letter, he'll be very pleased and reward you with a leveled amount of gold, as detailed below.

base_facts: I am the Guild Master of the Thieves Guild.
I decide who joins and what jobs they take.

MERCER_BRIEFING: I welcomed the new recruit and told Brynjolf to give them the Goldenglow assignment.

base_facts: I am a senior member of the Thieves Guild.
I was sent to investigate Goldenglow Estate and found it crawling with mercenaries.

OPTIONAL_VEX_INFO: I told the recruit about the sewer entrance on the northwest side of Goldenglow Estate.

base_facts: I have been pressured by the Thieves Guild for years.
An anonymous buyer recently purchased Goldenglow and told me to stop cooperating with the Guild.

beats.comment: Player follows Brynjolf to meet the Guild Master.
Player listens to Mercer Frey's welcome and receives the job assignment.
Brynjolf explains the Goldenglow job: burn three hives and clear Aringoth's safe.
Optional: Vex reveals the sewer entrance on the northwest side of Goldenglow.
Player burns three beehives and retrieves the Goldenglow Bill of Sale from Aringoth's safe.
Player returns to Brynjolf after completing the Goldenglow job.
Quest finishes. Player is rewarded and pointed to Maven Black-Briar for the next job.
